title: The Owner turns Frequency funnel page links on or off from Settings, on the Mac or on flowweb.app
description: Daniel (2026-11-11) asked for buttons to turn live links on and off. Today the switch is funnels_live in each flow's config plus FW_FUNNELS_LIVE=off in fwd's environment, both on the Mac. fwd now keeps one stored switch, funnels_live true, false or unset, in the Supervisor settings. When it is set it wins over the env var and every flow's config, so the button works even with FW_FUNNELS_LIVE set; unset keeps today's env-then-config behaviour. Every generated link honours it: hunts, neighborhood activation, host moments and the reply helper (funnelsLive keeps its two-argument form and takes the stored value as an optional third). GET /v1/supervisor/funnels-live answers { live, source: setting | env | config, setting, env_off }, GET /v1/supervisor carries the same as funnels_live so the hosted mirror shows it, and POST /v1/supervisor/funnels-live { live: true | false | null } sets or clears it (CLI token or paired session). The site queues links.funnels through hosted/server/requests.mjs and migration 0012 allows it with every kind 0011 allowed. Settings shows the switch (On, Off, Flow default) with one line: Off: drafts link to /create-a-space until Frequency's /start/host, /for/<niche> and /launch pages are live.
acceptance: POST /v1/supervisor/funnels-live { live: false } makes a drafted reply link go to /create-a-space while fwd runs with FW_FUNNELS_LIVE=on
POST { live: true } brings /for/<niche> back while fwd runs with FW_FUNNELS_LIVE=off; { live: null } hands it back to the env var
GET /v1/supervisor/funnels-live and GET /v1/supervisor show the value and where it came from; bad input 400; no session 401
A hunt link follows the stored switch over its flow's config
The site queues links.funnels and the relay maps it to the same route and body; migration 0012 allows it and every earlier kind
Settings renders the switch, shows the current value, and a click posts only { live }
